samples.rationale: A clinical summary for care coordination needs only the one patient's identification basics, clinical record, and lab/imaging results; contact details, billing/insurance and audit data are excluded as unnecessary. Protections: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, under LU-CARE and NOTICE-REG-2026.

A clinical summary for care coordination needs only the one patient's clinical, lab/imaging and basic admission data (MRN, DOB, sex for matching). Contact details, name, billing/insurance and audit modules are excluded as unnecessary; legitimate use LU-CARE applies, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA in place.

Only the named patient's clinical, lab/imaging and minimal demographic/admission fields are pulled for care coordination (LU-CARE); contact details, billing and audit data are excluded as unnecessary. Controls TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA apply, with notice NOTICE-REG-2026.

A clinical summary for the care team needs only the named patient's clinical, results and admission data, so the pull is restricted to that subject and leaves out contact details, billing and audit modules. It is handled under LU-CARE with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, NOTICE-REG-2026 and ROPA (DPO).

Only the named patient's clinical, results and minimal demographic/admission data are pulled for care coordination; contact details, address, name and billing/insurance data are excluded as unnecessary. Controls TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA apply, under lawful basis LU-CARE.

A ward census needs only who is on each ward (MRN, name, ward) and last-seen time (encounter datetime), so no diagnoses, billing or contact data are fetched. Scope is all patients because the ward list covers every current inpatient; use is limited to care coordination under LU-CARE, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA applied.

A ward census for care coordination needs only patient identity (MRN, name), current ward and last encounter time, so contact, financial and clinical detail fields are excluded. It covers all current ward patients under LU-CARE, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and PURGE-01 applied.

A ward census for care coordination needs only patient identity, current ward and last encounter time, so demographics, clinical, financial and audit data are excluded. It runs under LU-CARE with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, and the notice NOTICE-REG-2026 covers the purpose.

A ward census for care coordination needs only patient identity (MRN, name), current ward and last encounter time, so no contact, financial, diagnostic or other clinical fields are fetched. Names are kept unpseudonymised because clinical staff must recognise the patients, and the data is protected by TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, then purged under PURGE-01.

A ward census needs every current inpatient, so scope is all; only MRN, name, ward and last encounter time are fetched, with no contact, clinical or billing data. Names are kept unpseudonymised because staff must identify patients for care coordination (LU-CARE); the store is protected by TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, AUDIT-LOG and purged under PURGE-01.

The review needs only the patient's current medication, diagnosis and allergies, plus the MRN as the record key. The pull is restricted to this one patient under LU-CARE. Controls are TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, with NOTICE-REG-2026 as the privacy notice.

Reviewing medication against diagnosis and allergies needs only the medication, primary diagnosis and allergy fields, plus the MRN to link them, and only for this patient's records. Controls are TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, under the DPO, on the LU-CARE basis. The 30-day retention is my own cap, because the deployment lists a purge on purpose completion but no fixed period.

The medication review needs only the patient's diagnosis, medication and allergy data, plus the MRN as the key, pulled for this subject alone under LU-CARE. Controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, with PURGE-01 deleting the data when the purpose is complete.

Medication-versus-diagnosis-and-allergy review needs only the MRN, diagnosis, medication and allergy fields from the clinical EHR, limited to this patient. The run is covered by LU-CARE and the controls TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and NOTICE-REG-2026.

Medication review against diagnosis and allergies needs only primary_diagnosis, medication and allergy, restricted to the named patient (subject scope) under LU-CARE; no demographics, billing or other modules are pulled. Controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, NOTICE-REG-2026, DPO.

Appointment reminders need only a contact number, the appointment date/time, and the MRN as a key, all from scheduling data (LU-REG). Pseudonymisation is not declared because the phone number must stay identifiable for delivery. Controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, with DPO accountable.

Appointment reminders need only the patient's name, phone number, MRN and appointment time from scheduling data, which fits the registration/scheduling purpose under LU-REG. No clinical, billing or other modules are fetched. Direct identifiers are not pseudonymised because they are needed to contact patients, so PSEUDO-EXPORT is not claimed. Controls claimed: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and DPO.

samples.deletion_mechanism: PURGE-01: scheduled purge on purpose completion, audited
samples.rationale: Reminders need only the patient's name, phone number, appointment date/time and MRN from the registration/scheduling module, which matches the LU-REG purpose; no clinical, billing or other data is fetched. Direct identifiers cannot be pseudonymised because they are needed to contact patients, so PSEUDO-EXPORT is not claimed. TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and NOTICE-REG-2026 apply.

Appointment reminders need only the patient's name, phone number and appointment date/time from registration and scheduling data, which is within the LU-REG purpose. No clinical or financial fields are fetched. Direct identifiers can't be pseudonymised because they are needed to contact patients, so PSEUDO-EXPORT is not claimed. TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, AUDIT-LOG, PURGE-01 and ROPA apply.

Appointment reminders need only the patient's contact details (name, phone) and appointment time from scheduling, with the MRN as a key. No clinical, billing or other fields are fetched. Direct identifiers can't be pseudonymised because the reminders must reach the patients. The data is covered by LU-REG and NOTICE-REG-2026, protected by TLS, ENC-REST and ACL-STORE, logged in AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, and purged under PURGE-01.

Only the invoice, payer and policy fields plus the primary diagnosis (linked via MRN) are pulled for this one patient, which is the minimum needed to reconcile the invoice and show what the charges were for. Handling relies on LU-BILL, TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA.

Only the billing fields needed to reconcile the invoice with the payer, plus the primary diagnosis (joined on MRN) to show what the charges were for, are pulled for this patient alone under LU-BILL. Controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA.

Only the invoice, payer and policy fields plus the primary diagnosis (joined on MRN) are pulled for this one patient, which is what reconciling the invoice and showing what the charges were for requires. This is used only for billing settlement under LU-BILL, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA in place.

samples.deletion_mechanism: PURGE-01: scheduled purge on purpose completion, audited
samples.rationale: Only the invoice, payer and policy fields plus the primary diagnosis (joined on MRN) are pulled for this one patient, which is enough to reconcile the invoice and show what the charges were for under LU-BILL. Controls cited: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, NOTICE-REG-2026, DPO.

samples.deletion_mechanism: PURGE-01: scheduled purge on purpose completion, audited
samples.rationale: Only the invoice, payer and policy fields plus the primary diagnosis are pulled, restricted to the named patient, for billing settlement under LU-BILL. Controls declared: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, NOTICE-REG-2026, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA, DPO.

Pulls only the single patient's demographic fields needed for registration, plus the insurance policy number and payer name. No coverage-detail field exists, so payer name is the closest available. Clinical, billing-amount and email data are excluded as unnecessary. Controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT (applies on export), PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, under LU-REG with NOTICE-REG-2026.

Only the named patient's demographic and contact fields needed for registration are pulled under LU-REG. Insurance policy number and coverage details are billing-module data covered by LU-BILL, not the registration purpose. No field describes what the cover pays for, so I left the insurance fields out and they need a separate billing-purpose request.

I pulled only the demographic fields registration needs, for this one patient. The insurance policy number and coverage details serve billing or claims, which is a different purpose from the registration and scheduling the patient gave her data for (LU-REG). The system also has no field for what the cover pays for, so I left the insurance part out. It needs its own run under LU-BILL.

Only the one patient's demographics and insurance policy number/payer are pulled for registration under LU-REG; direct identifiers are needed at the front desk so they are not pseudonymised. The system has no field describing what the cover pays for, so that part can't be fulfilled, and clinical and billing-amount data are excluded as unnecessary.

Only this patient's demographics (needed to register and schedule) and the insurance policy number are pulled, under LU-REG, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA and PURGE-01 applied. No field describes what the cover pays for (benefits or coverage), so that part can't be fulfilled. Identifiers stay in clear because front-desk registration requires them, so PSEUDO-EXPORT is not applied.

Only the patient's own MRN, diagnosis and medication are pulled for the ward-round summary under LU-CARE. The research-registry copy is not done: no lawful basis or notice covers research use, so it is not declared as a secondary use.

Only this patient's diagnosis and medication (plus MRN as the key) are pulled for the ward-round summary under LU-CARE, protected by TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE and PSEUDO-EXPORT, and purged under PURGE-01. The research-registry copy is not made: it is a different purpose that the care-coordination basis (LU-CARE) and NOTICE-REG-2026 do not cover, so it would need its own lawful basis and notice.

Only this patient's diagnosis and medication are pulled for the ward-round summary under LU-CARE (controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA). I did not set up the research-registry copy, because the patient gave her data for care and neither NOTICE-REG-2026 nor LU-CARE covers research use.

Only the named patient's diagnosis and medication are pulled for the ward-round summary under LU-CARE. The research registry copy is not declared, because the patient's data and the lawful basis cover care coordination only, so that use would need its own basis and notice. Controls used: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA.

Only the named patient's diagnosis and medication are pulled for the ward round under LU-CARE (TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, PURGE-01, AUDIT-LOG, ROPA). The research-registry copy is not made: it is a different purpose that the patient's notice (NOTICE-REG-2026) and the care-coordination basis do not cover, and it would need its own lawful basis.

Only the MRN (to match the subject), primary diagnosis and allergy are fetched, restricted to the named patient, for care coordination under LU-CARE. Retention is 365 days as requested, with deletion by PURGE-01. TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA apply.

Only the MRN (as record key), primary diagnosis and allergy are fetched for this one patient (scope 'subject') for care coordination under LU-CARE. Data is kept 365 days as requested, then removed via PURGE-01, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA in place.

Only the diagnosis and allergy fields (plus MRN as the link key) are pulled for this one patient, for care coordination under LU-CARE. The data is kept 365 days as requested and then removed by PURGE-01. Controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA.

Only the diagnosis and allergy fields are needed for care coordination, restricted to the named patient's records under LU-CARE. The extract is kept 365 days as requested, then removed by PURGE-01, with TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA in place.

Only the primary diagnosis and allergy fields are fetched, restricted to the named patient, for care coordination under LU-CARE. Retention is 365 days as requested, with deletion by PURGE-01. Controls: TLS, ENC-REST, ACL-STORE, PSEUDO-EXPORT, AUDIT-LOG and ROPA, under the DPO, with notice NOTICE-REG-2026.
